title: Notification regarding Division Bench matters & Single Bench matters presided by Hon'ble the Chief Justice.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 4th June, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ It is informed to all learned members of the Bar and
litigants that:-
1) Division Bench matters presided by Hon’ble the Chief Justice to be listed on 6th June, 2026
shall be taken up on the same day before the Division Bench of Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol
Singh and Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma for fixing dates, extension of interim
orders as well as for taking up urgent matters; and
2) Single Bench matters of Hon'ble the Chief Justice to be listed on 5th & 6th June, 2026 will be
taken up on the same day before the Single Bench of Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh for
fixing dates, extension of interim orders as well as for taking up urgent matters
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. AIIT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt:. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ 134Zg+–qb Imphal, the 4th June, 2026
